description: Current league standing. Sourced from standings snapshot; not derived from match legs.
interpretation: League position - 1 = top of the table

description: Total points earned in the form window: 3 per win, 1 per draw, 0 per loss.
numerator: 3 if W / 1 if D / 0 if L
interpretation: Points tally in the window (3 per win / 1 per draw / 0 per loss)

description: Average goals scored per match in the form window.
interpretation: Attacking output - goals scored per game; high = a potent attack

description: Average goals conceded per match in the form window.
interpretation: Defensive vulnerability - goals conceded per game; low = a mean defence

description: Matches with zero goals conceded in the window, shown as a count of games played (e.g. 3/5).
interpretation: Shut-out rate - games conceding zero; high = reliable at the back

description: Average total shots attempted per match with available team stats in the window. Includes on-target, off-target and blocked shots.
interpretation: Shot volume - attacking attempts per game; high-volume but not necessarily high-quality

description: Share of shots that were on target. Total shots include blocked shots. Null when shots_total is zero.
interpretation: Striking precision - share of shots on target

description: Share of shots taken from inside the penalty area. Null when shots_total is zero.
interpretation: Chance quality - share of shots from inside the box; high = better positions

description: Average shots on target per match with available shots-on-target stats in the window (its own coverage count — same-window rule).
interpretation: On-target threat - efforts testing the keeper; high = sustained threat

description: Goals per shot on target, over matches with shot stats available (numerator and denominator share the window). Can exceed 100% when a goal is not counted as a shot on target (penalties, own goals in the team's favour) — shown uncapped. Null when shots_on_goal is zero.
interpretation: Clinical finishing - goals per shot on target; high = ruthless

description: Average duels contested per match. Aggregated from player stats; inherits player-stat coverage gaps. Volume context for the duel win rate.
interpretation: Duel engagement - physical contests per game; a combative/contested style

description: Duel win rate in the form window. Null when duels_total is zero. Aggregated from player stats.
interpretation: Duel success - share of duels won; high = wins the physical battle

description: Average defensive actions per match: tackles + interceptions + blocks. Aggregated from player stats; inherits player-stat coverage gaps. Displayed with the T/I/B breakdown.
interpretation: Defensive workload - tackles + interceptions + blocks per game; high = a deep block or an aggressive press

description: Average tackles per match. Aggregated from player stats; inherits player-stat coverage gaps.
interpretation: Tackling volume - ball-winning challenges per game

description: Average interceptions per match. Aggregated from player stats; inherits player-stat coverage gaps.
interpretation: Interception volume - reading and cutting out passes

description: Average shots blocked per match. Aggregated from player stats; inherits player-stat coverage gaps.
interpretation: Block volume - bodies in front of shots

description: Average passes attempted per match with available team stats in the window.
interpretation: Possession volume - high = possession-based style; low = direct

description: Share of passes successfully completed. Null when passes_total is zero.
interpretation: Passing security - completion rate; high = keeps the ball well

description: Average key passes per match. Aggregated from player stats; inherits player-stat coverage gaps.
interpretation: Creativity - passes leading to a shot; high = creates chances

description: Average corner kicks won per match with available team stats in the window.
interpretation: Corner volume won - sustained attacking pressure (a weak proxy)

description: Average corner kicks conceded per match with available opponent stats in the window.
interpretation: Corners conceded - defensive pressure faced (a weak proxy)

description: Share of shots on target faced that were saved. Self-bounding denominator (saves + goals conceded in save-covered games). Null when no save-covered games.
interpretation: Shot-stopping - share of on-target shots saved; high = strong keeping

description: Goals scored in the form window.
Goal assists in the form window.
Penalties won in the form window.
Shots on target in the form window.
Duels won in the form window. A duel is any 1v1 physical contest (ground and aerial pooled).
Total duels contested in the form window.
Duel win rate. Null when duels_total is zero.
interpretation: Share of duels won; high = consistently wins physical contests.

description: Successful dribbles in the form window.
Dribble attempts in the form window.
Dribble success rate. Null when dribbles_attempts is zero.
interpretation: Share of take-ons completed; high = a reliable dribbler.

description: Tackles made in the form window.
Interceptions in the form window.
Shots blocked in the form window.
Times dribbled past by an opponent in the form window.
Accurate passes in the form window. Derived as SUM(passes_total × passes_accuracy_percent / 100). Inherits small per-fixture rounding error.
Total passes attempted in the form window.
Pass completion rate. Null when passes_total is zero.
interpretation: Share of passes completed; high = a secure and reliable passer.

description: Key passes in the form window. API definition: a pass leading directly to a shot.
Yellow cards in the form window.
Red cards in the form window.
Offsides caught in the form window.
Penalties committed in the form window.
Saves made in the form window.
Shots on target faced in the form window. Derived as saves + goals conceded.
Goalkeeper save percentage. Null when denominator is zero.
interpretation: Share of shots on target saved; high = a strong shot-stopper.

description: Total shots (on and off target) in the form window.

Goals per shot on target in the form window. Aggregated over fixtures with player stats (inherits player-stat coverage gaps, like the other player rates). Shown uncapped: in rare cases the source logs more goals than on-target shots for a player, so the value can exceed 100%. Null when shots_on_target is zero.
interpretation: Goals per shot on target; high = a clinical and ruthless finisher.

description: Goals conceded by the team while the player was on the pitch (GK-relevant). Form window.
Share of all shots in the team's matches taken by the team. Null when no shots.
interpretation: Shooting dominance - share of the match's shots; high = controls the chances (deserved-vs-actual input)

description: Share of available points won (points / (3 * games)).
interpretation: Results efficiency - share of available points won (deserved-vs-actual input)

description: Goals plus assists (combined goal contributions).
Tackles plus interceptions plus blocks (combined defensive actions).
Yellow plus red cards (total cards shown). A second yellow is recorded by the provider as a yellow plus a red, so a two-yellow dismissal counts as 3.
Goals per 90 minutes played. Minutes-normalised so playing time does not distort the comparison. Null when minutes is zero.
interpretation: Scoring frequency; high = a prolific and dependable goalscorer.

description: Goal assists per 90 minutes played. Minutes-normalised. Null when minutes is zero.
interpretation: How often the player creates goals for others; high = a frequent creator.

description: Goals plus assists per 90 minutes played. Minutes-normalised. Null when minutes is zero.
interpretation: Total goal involvement (goals + assists); high = drives the team's attacking output.

description: Shots on target per 90 minutes played. Minutes-normalised. Null when minutes is zero.
interpretation: How often the player tests the keeper; high = a persistent attacking threat.

description: Key passes (passes leading to a shot) per 90 minutes played. Minutes-normalised. Null when minutes is zero.
interpretation: Shot-creating passes; high = a creative hub who makes chances.

description: Successful dribbles per 90 minutes played. Minutes-normalised. Null when minutes is zero.
interpretation: Take-ons completed; high = a dangerous ball-carrier who beats opponents.

description: Passes attempted per 90 minutes played. Minutes-normalised. Null when minutes is zero.
interpretation: Passing involvement; high = a possession-anchoring role; low = a more direct role. Style not quality.

description: Tackles per 90 minutes played. Minutes-normalised. Null when minutes is zero.
interpretation: Tackling volume; high = an aggressive ball-winner; low = positional. Style not quality - high can reflect a side often defending.

description: Interceptions per 90 minutes played. Minutes-normalised. Null when minutes is zero.
interpretation: Interception volume; high = reads play and steps into passing lanes. Style not quality.

description: Blocks per 90 minutes played. Minutes-normalised. Null when minutes is zero.
interpretation: Blocks made; high = throws the body in; often a side under pressure. Style not quality.

description: Defensive actions (tackles + interceptions + blocks) per 90 minutes played. Minutes-normalised. Null when minutes is zero.
interpretation: Overall defensive workload (tackles + interceptions + blocks); high = a deep block or aggressive press. Style not quality.

description: Duels won per 90 minutes played. Minutes-normalised. Null when minutes is zero.
interpretation: Physical duels won; high = heavily and successfully involved in duels. Volume - the win rate captures efficiency.

description: Goalkeeper saves per 90 minutes played. Minutes-normalised. Null when minutes is zero.
interpretation: Save volume; high = a busy keeper facing many shots; not shot-stopping quality - the save rate captures that.
